overall: The AG found no violation. The Board posted an executive session topic but never convened in executive session, so the notice's sufficiency was not a violation; the letter gave guidance on litigation and negotiation topic detail.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Feb. 26, 2016 meeting notice lacked sufficient detail about the anticipated executive session topic.
allegations.key_passage: When a public body does not actually engage in deliberation on a noticed topic, the Open Meeting Law is not violated with respect to the sufficiency of the meeting notice.
